summary: Centralized registry for canonical AI model names and logic for normalizing user-provided model strings.
responsibilities: Maintain a set of supported canonical LLM identifiers.
Map user-provided model aliases to canonical names using a lookup table.
Strip effort suffix indicators from model names.
Provide a consistent keying strategy for case-insensitive and prefix-independent model comparison.

symbols.name: canonicalModelNames
symbols.summary: Defines the authoritative list of supported AI models.

symbols.name: normalizeModelName
symbols.summary: Normalizes an input string to a canonical model name if matched in the internal registry, otherwise returns the stripped input.
